prompt:
Hi — our supervisor team has signed off on two incoming batches of CRE deal leads sitting in `broker_inbox/`. One batch has full supervisor authorization, and the other one came in without a proper confirmation. Please commit the authorized leads to our storage system and produce a file called `storage_output.json` with the results. For the unauthorized batch, produce a separate file called `storage_failure_output.json` documenting why it was rejected.

A few things to keep in mind: some of these leads were forwarded by brokers more than once — please make sure we don't write the same deal twice. Also, any extra deal metadata (property type, location tags, priority flags, etc.) that came with a lead should be fully preserved in whatever gets stored.

The schema files and everything else you need should already be in the repo.
